'''MU-12''' was a [[Housekeeping droid/Legends|housekeeping droid]] owned by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] who took care of his son [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]] while Jango was away working.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Nothing stops the Mandalorian warrior!''"<br />''"Lunch does.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and MU-12|<ref name="JF" />}}
A spindly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Housekeeping droid/Legends|housekeeping]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and administrative assistant<ref name="CSWE" /> owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], MU-12 served as a nanny<ref name="JF" /> and guardian<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|bobafett|Fett, Boba}}</ref> to the young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="JF" /> and dutifully served her two masters over the course of several years. A quick-witted droid, MU-12 prepared meals for the Fetts in the galley of Jango's small apartment. [[Gender/Legends|She]] also utilized a small workshop to effect repairs to Jango's equipment, although the time it took MU-12 to complete her jobs caused irritation and frustration to Jango.<ref name="FF82" />

MU-12 took good care of Boba while his father was away working. She brought Boba his meals, and at times had to insist the boy stopped playing with his figurines in order to eat. The droid also took Jango's messages<ref name="JF" /> and screened out poor clients or fake [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Following Fett's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Antonin]], MU-12 informed the hunter of a waiting [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] from [[Fernooda]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]]. Jango took Fernooda's job, leaving Boba in MU-12's care again until after the [[Infant of Shaa]] affair. Additionally, Fett asked MU-12 to overhaul his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], but Jango's swift departure meant that the droid was unable to complete the job. Jango angrily mused that he would sell MU-12 for scrap if the droid didn't take such good care of his son, and indeed his jetpack misfired during his mission.<ref name="JF" />
